name: register_claim
description: Create a motor FNOL claim. Call this ONLY after the caller has clearly confirmed the vehicle, incident summary, deductible, and garage choice. Set caller_confirmed to true only for an explicit yes such as 'yes', 'go ahead', or 'please register it'. Never call this to check eligibility, quote a price, or preview a claim ID. If anyone is injured, do not call this tool; escalate instead. If the caller has not confirmed, do not call it.
pre_call_message: I am registering the claim now.

policy_number.description: Verified policy number, for example POL-DGT-4821.

vehicle_registration.description: Verified registration if you have it.

incident_date.description: Incident date as YYYY-MM-DD, or the word today.

incident_description.description: One-sentence description of the damage, for example front bumper scrape at a signal.

injury.description: True if any person was hurt. If true the API will refuse registration.

third_party_involved.description: True if another vehicle or property was involved.

garage_id.description: garageId from find_cashless_garages for the garage the caller accepted, for example GRG-BLR-IND.

caller_confirmed.description: Must be true only after explicit confirmation. Otherwise do not call this function.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this call, such as policy number plus incident date, to avoid duplicate filings if the caller repeats yes.
